newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission still probing Veba buy of Degussa.
newsitem.headline: Commission still probing Veba buy of Degussa.

text.p: The European Commission has extended until September 2 its deadline to rule on Veba AG's planned acquisition of a 36.4-percent stake in Degussa AG, Commission sources said on Tuesday.
This was because until very recently it had not received all the information needed to assess the effects of the deal on competition.
"We discovered rather late in the process that one crucial point of information was missing," one source said, declining to give any details.
The deal was submitted for EU regulatory approval on July 2.

Under the European merger control law, the Commission has a month to decide whether to clear a deal or start an in-depth investigation. It may extend its preliminary inquiry if the file is not complete.
Veba, a diversified German utilities group, said in May it would buy the 36.4-percent stake in Degussa, making it the largest shareholder in the chemicals and metals group.
Veba said it was buying Chemiewerte GmbH, which held the Degussa stake, for 29 billion marks. Previous owners of Chemiewerte were Henkel KGaA, Dresdner Bank AG and Munich Re.
